title: Verification evidence record
description: One record per verification run, written by COMPL and the guided certification (SYS-REQ-028). Stored under validation/. Owner: COMPL. Behavior: docs/components/compliance.md.

id.description: Acceptance criterion or scenario ID, e.g. KV-AC-003, E2E-004.

status.description: blocked: a prerequisite was missing. not-run: not executed.

detail.description: Required for blocked and not-run: the reason. For a failure that came from an HTTP response: the observed status, error code, and requestId.

versions.description: Exact framework and dependency versions; never secrets.

leftovers.description: Cloud resources the run could not remove.

dryRun.description: Present only on a run against fakes (fake stage operations or overridden not-run rules): what was faked. Such a record is never evidence; the traceability and release reports ignore it.
